title: MOVE: Multimodal Open-world Verification and Expansion for Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00268v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal graph learning faces a fundamental challenge: new classes may emerge after deployment, while models are trained with a fixed label space. Existing approaches typically detect unknown nodes and use LLMs to generate candidate class descriptions, but they do not determine whether existing classes are insufficient to cover these nodes or whether a generated class is reliable enough to expand the class space. Our empirical study reveals three challenges: multimodal information beyond individual modalities is required for unknown-node identification, LLM-generated class descriptions may not fully capture multimodal class characteristics, and directly adding candidate classes can introduce redundant categories. Based on these observations, we propose MOVE, a multimodal open-world class verification and expansion framework. translated_title: MOVE：面向图学习的多模态开放世界验证与扩展
translated_abstract: 多模态图学习面临一个根本性挑战：模型在部署后可能遇到新的类别，而训练时却使用固定的标签空间。现有方法通常检测未知节点，并使用大语言模型生成候选类别描述，但它们既没有判断现有类别是否不足以覆盖这些节点，也没有判断生成的类别是否足够可靠以扩展类别空间。我们的实证研究揭示了三个挑战：未知节点的识别需要超越单一模态的多模态信息；LLM生成的类别描述可能无法充分捕捉多模态的类别特征；直接添加候选类别可能引入冗余类别。基于这些观察，我们提出了MOVE，一个多模态开放世界类别验证与扩展框架。MOVE通过联合考虑视觉token、文本等信息来识别无法被分配到现有类别的节点。
tldr: MOVE提出了一个多模态开放世界验证与扩展框架，通过联合利用视觉与文本等多模态信息识别无法归入现有类别的节点，并可靠地验证与扩展新类别，同时避免引入冗余类别。
en_tdlr: MOVE is a multimodal open-world verification and expansion framework that jointly leverages visual and textual information to identify nodes beyond existing classes and reliably expand the class space without introducing redundant categories.
